data.title: The Last One, ep. 2: The Last Umbrella
data.why: Ep. 2 in the ep. 1 format. First rain of the season, a corniche kiosk at night under blue-violet street light, one plain black umbrella left on the rack. A guy holding flowers and a woman with a laptop bag reach for it at the same time (close-up of two hands), freeze-frame name tags, a split-screen stare-down with bid pop-ups (amounts blurred), Going once… Going twice… Then a black car pulls up, the window rolls down and Marwan raises one finger. The kiosk owner hands him the umbrella through the window and he drives off, bone dry; Hammer falling, end card. Built from 6 single-action shots: 3 clips on Kling 3.0 (10 credits per 5 s) plus 3 still close-ups animated in the edit, about 40 credits. The balance is 22.5 credits, so approving this needs a top-up; or write "Flow" in the note and I'll write the Flow prompts for you to generate, like ep. 1 (no Higgsfield credits). On hold (13 Oct, 15:11): approved, but the Higgsfield balance is 0 credits, so nothing has been generated yet. Top up about 40 credits and the next check will make it, or write "Flow" in the note to switch to Flow prompts.

data.title: Arabic test 1: في مطرح إلك (golden-hour office)
data.why: Your first Arabic (Lebanese) test, in your own voice: "تعرف شو اللي بيخلّي الشغل يكبر؟ الناس الصحّ. ومع HyperBidz، في مطرح إلك." The question types itself right-to-left in a glass panel up in the ceiling. On "الناس الصحّ" four people pop in along an arc, each with a violet check, linked into a network. On "ومع HyperBidz" the Z on the wall flares and blasts a shockwave. On "في مطرح إلك" the row opens and an empty dashed seat spins in the middle, + and مطرحك (your place), with a shockwave on "إلك". Arabic captions (Readex Pro), warm groove, last shot held with a push-in, Arabic end card: "في مطرح إلك. على HyperBidz." I removed the floating HyperBidz watermark Veo put in the ceiling and the Apple logo on the laptop. Needs your approval.
